system.description:
Smarts; 4 Shock; Medium (50 ft). Electrocute: Shock damage is doubled against a target standing in water. Spray'n'Pray: every other enemy within 5 ft of the target must pass a CR 1 Luck Check or also be hit by the Strike.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.142
system.summary: Smarts; 4 Shock; Medium (50 ft). Electrocute: Shock damage is doubled against a target standing in water. Spray'n'Pray: every other enemy within 5 ft of the target must pass a CR 1 Luck Check or also be hit by the Strike.

automation.note: Electrocute: if the target is in water, the Shock damage is doubled. Add the extra wounds by hand.
Spray'n'Pray: each other enemy within 5 ft of the target makes a CR 1 Luck Check. Those that fail are also hit by this Strike.
